Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestUtcInstant_test_toTaiInstant.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestUtcInstant/TestUtcInstant_test_toTaiInstant.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original file contains a lot of dead code — data-provider methods (`data_badParse`, `data_withModifiedJulianDay`, `data_plus`, etc.) and a helper (`doTest_comparisons_UtcInstant`) that the single `test_toTaiInstant` method never uses, plus many unused imports and constants. I'll produce a focused, well-documented version that preserves the exact runtime behaviour.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). I refactored `TestUtcInstant_test_toTaiInstant.java` by removing all dead code (unused data providers, the comparison helper, and unused imports/constants), and rewrote the single test with descriptive loop variables (`dayOffset`, `extraSeconds`), named constants explaining the TAI epoch and 10-second offset, and a named `expectedTaiSeconds` — all while preserving identical calls, arguments, and assertions.
